verdict.rationale: Xero documents JAX, its own AI finance partner, which reconciles bank transactions by categorizing and matching them, so the matching core of the story is first-party. The evidence does not show a month-end close workflow, exception flagging during reconciliation, or a close package prepared for human review. Missing for 10: end-to-end month-close orchestration, flagging of reconciliation exceptions, close preparation and human-review handoff, independent or hands-on corroboration of JAX reconciliation quality.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review

citations.quote: JAX, your AI finance partner, reconciles your transactions for you.
Let JAX categorize and match transactions while you're busy with your real work.
